style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: THE RAIL is a motorised conveyor that never stops for a single frame: it carries HER through the aisle in EVERY beat, so shelves, coats and hangers streak past HER in EVERY beat even while she reads; SHE fills half the frame height, chest up from 6.8; camera rides beside HER low and level, moving in every beat, new shot size each beat; one clear action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor darting ahead at lens all clip, never still; A SWARM of moths streaming along the rail with a dry flutter in every beat
props: ONE fat folder of bills inside her coat; ONE long strip of bills unrolling from it; TWO mink coats gliding on the conveyor; ONE red-stamped bill; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: THE STRIP of bills streams behind her in the slipstream from 1.3 on, never parked; the folder rides inside the coat until 1.3; the sleeve she chews stays on her own coat
environment: a sun-flooded store aisle, a motorised conveyor rail of fur coats, white shelves, hard noon sun

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, PA-ra, shub, NOR-ki, poch-TI, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.4-4.3 one breath; pause 4.3-4.7; 4.7-6.8 one breath; after 6.8 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: conveyor rumble all clip, dry wing flutter, paper riffling, fur ripping, one wet spit at 7.6

timeline.a: the conveyor sweeps her into frame at full speed in her mink coat, the aisle streaking past, THE SWARM streaming after her
she rides right to left chewing her own sleeve, shelves streaking past, CLERK darting ahead at lens
she yanks THE FOLDER out of her coat and a long strip of bills bursts open and streams behind her in the wind
she spits on one finger, the aisle streaking past her the whole beat
she flicks through the bills, they flutter hard in the slipstream, coats swinging past
she sighs and THE STRIP whips out long behind her as the conveyor rounds a bend
CLERK slaps a red-stamped bill onto THE STRIP at lens, and both are dragged right to left off frame
the conveyor swings her hard right to left around a bend, the coats swinging wide behind her
she leans out at the lens, shelves tearing past
she rides left to right past the last bare hanger, THE SWARM tearing across after her
chest-up close shot: she bites her own sleeve, rips a long strip of fur off it and chews hard, the aisle still streaking behind her
she spits the chewed wad of fur straight at the lens, face to camera, the conveyor still hauling her past the streaking shelves

must_appear: at 2.2 she spits on her finger and flicks through the bills; at 6.8 a chest-up shot of her biting her own sleeve and chewing; at 7.4 she spits the chewed wad at the lens, face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped conveyor, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, a glowing emblem, a logo, human hands, speech after 6.8
